dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge curve transitioning from a near-vertical orientation at the apex to a roughly 160-degree horizontal flare at the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a very small pixel radius, creating a sharp, pointed terminus.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 65-70 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1.2 ratio of maximum basal width to vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white punctate markings and small circular speckles distributed along the lateral body surface; minor irregular indentations on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical height of the dorsal fin relative to the visible anterior body profile.
